verdict.rationale: Puzzle markets an 'Embedded Accounting' API (puzzle.io/api) claiming it powers automated bookkeeping and financial data access, but no technical API reference, auth model, or endpoint documentation is provided, and direct probes for OpenAPI/swagger specs at expected paths all returned 404, contradicting the claim of a documented public API. Missing for 10: actual API reference docs, endpoint/schema definitions, authentication guide, working OpenAPI spec discoverable by probes.
